verdict.rationale: The RTX 5090 has an official developer ecosystem (the CUDA Toolkit, CUDA Tile C++, cuTile Python, Nsight), so asking whether it offers an interactive API reference is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference with runnable examples. The docs only describe the toolkits in general terms, and the probes found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec and no markdown docs, only an llms.txt index.
